components.name: zerofrom-derive
components.description: Custom derive for the zerofrom crate

components.name: zerofrom
components.description: ZeroFrom trait for constructing

components.name: zeroize
components.description: Securely clear secrets from memory with a simple trait built on stable Rust primitives which guarantee memory is zeroed using an operation will not be 'optimized away' by the compiler. Uses a portable pure Rust implementation that works everywhere, even WASM!

components.name: zeroize_derive
components.description: Custom derive support for zeroize

components.name: zerotrie
components.description: A data structure that efficiently maps strings to integers

components.name: zerovec-derive
components.description: Custom derive for the zerovec crate

components.name: zerovec
components.description: Zero-copy vector backed by a byte array

components.name: zip
components.description: Library to support the reading and writing of zip files.

components.name: zlib-rs
components.description: A memory-safe zlib implementation written in rust

components.name: zmij
components.description: A double-to-string conversion algorithm based on Schubfach and yy

components.name: zopfli
components.description: A Rust implementation of the Zopfli compression algorithm.
